Text to diagram. Wireframe to code. Mermaid to Excalidraw. Try out our new AI generative features.
AI in Excalidraw
Hey Excalidraw fans,

AI generative features just landed in Excalidraw. You can try them out whether you use excalidraw.com or Excalidraw+ — just click on the "more tools" button in your toolbar and pick either of the AI-powered features for textual and visual prompting.
Text to diagram (AI)
Make your boilerplate for diagrams fast. Create technical sequence diagrams, project workflows and more using just a simple text prompt.
Wireframe to code (AI)
With this advanced feature you can turn simple wireframes to interactive mockups, or even create simple arcade games right within the editor.

For now you need your own OpenAI token for this specific feature, but soon it will come bundled with your Excalidraw+ account.
Mermaid to Excalidraw
Don't forget you can always use a Mermaid definition directly if that's what you fancy. Our Text-to-diagram currently uses Mermaid as well, and you can view and edit the Mermaid source after generation as per your needs!
All these tools are currently in beta and in active development. Let us know your thoughts and what else you'd like to see!
